pharma.title: Lupin Receives U.S. FDA Approval for Glycerol Phenylbutyrate Oral Liquid
pharma.summary: Pharma major Lupin has received approval from the U.S. FDA for its Glycerol Phenylbutyrate Oral Liquid, which is the generic equivalent of Ravicti®. The drug is indicated for the chronic management of adult and pediatric patients with urea cycle disorders.

pharma.title: US FDA Moves to Restrict Large-Scale Compounding of Weight Loss Drugs
pharma.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration moved to restrict large-scale compounding of three widely used weight loss medications. The measure aims to curb safety risks associated with mass-produced unapproved compounded formulations.

pharma.title: Aurobindo Pharma Announces Resignation of Apitoria Pharma CEO
pharma.summary: Aurobindo Pharma announced that Dr. Sanjay Chaturvedi has resigned from his role as Chief Executive Officer of its active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) subsidiary, Apitoria Pharma.

national.title: Government Shields Fuel Buyers Amid Crude Spike, Rules Out Relief for Oil PSUs
national.summary: The Indian government has ruled out immediate financial relief for state-run oil marketing companies amid rising global crude oil prices, opting instead to protect retail fuel consumers from price hikes.

national.title: West Bengal Assembly Election Results Declared
national.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party achieved a historic victory in the West Bengal assembly elections, marking a major political shift in the state as key leaders, including Padma Bhushan awardee Swapan Dasgupta, secured constituency wins.

international.title: US Announces 'Project Freedom' for Maritime Security in Strait of Hormuz
international.summary: The United States has launched 'Project Freedom,' an initiative aimed at escorting and protecting stranded commercial vessels navigating through the volatile Strait of Hormuz.

international.title: Nepal Objects to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra via Lipulekh Pass
international.summary: Nepal raised fresh objections regarding India's route for the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through the Lipulekh pass, prompting a response from India's Ministry of External Affairs reaffirming territorial rights.

international.title: Outgoing Indian Envoy Meets Bangladesh Foreign Minister
international.summary: The outgoing Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh held a bilateral meeting with the Bangladeshi Foreign Minister to review ongoing development projects and strengthen regional diplomatic ties.

economy.title: India's Manufacturing PMI Rises to 54.7 in April
economy.summary: India's Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose to 54.7 in April, reflecting robust operational expansion, although input cost pressures touched a 44-month high.

economy.title: India and Canada Begin Second Round of CEPA Trade Talks
economy.summary: Negotiators from India and Canada have initiated the second round of discussions for the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) to boost bilateral trade and investment flows.

economy.title: Rohit Jain Takes Charge as RBI Deputy Governor; Portfolios Reallocated
economy.summary: Rohit Jain officially took charge as a Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India, leading to a reallocation of key departmental portfolios among the central bank's deputy governors.

science.title: Centre Revamps Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)
science.summary: The Union Health Ministry has expanded the Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK) framework to include comprehensive screening for adolescent mental health conditions and early-onset non-communicable diseases (NCDs).

science.title: 'ParSEC Whitefield' Living Lab Opens in Bengaluru
science.summary: A 30,000 sq. ft. interactive science lab facility named 'ParSEC Whitefield' has been inaugurated in Bengaluru as a 'Living Lab' to promote hands-on scientific learning for students and citizens.

science.title: India Launches National Hospital Fire Safety Week
science.summary: The Union Government launched a nationwide Hospital Fire Safety Week program to mandate strict safety audits, disaster prevention protocols, and mock drills across public and private healthcare facilities.

environment.title: Study Finds Microplastics Trap Atmospheric Heat
environment.summary: A new scientific study revealed that airborne microplastics trap infrared radiation in the atmosphere, directly contributing to micro-climatic warming and global climate change dynamics.

environment.title: NITI Aayog and Industry Push for Common Extended Producer Responsibility Portal
environment.summary: NITI Aayog and key industrial stakeholders have recommended setting up a unified Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) portal to streamline plastic waste management and strengthen India's recycling infrastructure.

sports.title: Esports Organisation S8UL Signs Grandmaster M. Pranesh
sports.summary: Leading Indian esports and gaming organization S8UL announced the signing of Chess Grandmaster M. Pranesh to bolster its growing intellectual sports division.

awards_honours.title: Bharat Gite Conferred 'Global Inspiration of the Year 2026' Award
awards_honours.summary: Bharat Gite, Founder of manufacturing firm Taural India, was awarded the prestigious 'Global Inspiration of the Year 2026' at a global leadership ceremony.

defence.title: CDS Confirms Submission of Theatre Command Recommendations
defence.summary: Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) announced that final recommendations for establishing joint Theatre Commands have been submitted, with a Joint Operations Centre scheduled to be functional by late May.

defence.title: India Clears Bay of Bengal Airspace for Long-Range Missile Test
defence.summary: India issued a NOTAM (Notice to Airmen) clearing a designated corridor in the Bay of Bengal airspace in preparation for testing a strategic long-range missile.

schemes_appointments.title: Prasoon Joshi Appointed as Chairman of Prasar Bharati
schemes_appointments.summary: Renowned media executive and creative leader Prasoon Joshi has been appointed as the new Chairman of India's public broadcaster, Prasar Bharati.

important_days.title: International Firefighters' Day 2026 Observed Globally
important_days.summary: International Firefighters' Day was observed on May 4 to honor the sacrifices and dedication of firefighters worldwide, marked by emergency preparedness drills and tributes.

important_days.title: Ministry of Ayush Prepares for International Day of Yoga 2026
important_days.summary: The Ministry of Ayush convened an Inter-Ministerial Committee meeting on May 4 to finalize national programs and global outreach strategy for the upcoming International Day of Yoga.

mcqs.q: Which pharmaceutical company received U.S. FDA approval for Glycerol Phenylbutyrate Oral Liquid, the generic equivalent of Ravicti®?
mcqs.explanation: Lupin received U.S. FDA approval for its generic Glycerol Phenylbutyrate Oral Liquid, which is used for managing urea cycle disorders.

mcqs.q: What is the name of the maritime initiative launched by the United States to escort stranded commercial vessels through the Strait of Hormuz?
mcqs.explanation: The US announced 'Project Freedom' to escort and secure stranded commercial ships navigating through the Strait of Hormuz.

mcqs.q: What was India's Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) value recorded for April 2026?
mcqs.explanation: India's Manufacturing PMI rose to 54.7 in April 2026, indicating sustained economic expansion despite high input cost inflation.

mcqs.q: Who has been appointed as the new Chairman of Prasar Bharati in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Prasoon Joshi was appointed as the new Chairman of India's public service broadcaster, Prasar Bharati.

mcqs.q: Regarding the structural reforms in the Indian Armed Forces announced in May 2026, recommendations were submitted for which of the following?
mcqs.explanation: The Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) announced that recommendations for joint Theatre Commands have been submitted, along with plans for a Joint Ops Centre by end of May.
